findings.title: ApplyEdit bypasses the E17 terminal barrier Step enforces — post-terminal live edits mutate a frozen run (topology + action log)
findings.evidence: inline FEditResult ApplyEdit(FSimState &State, const FCommand &Cmd) { FEditResult Result = ApplyDraw(State.Topology, Cmd.A, Cmd.B, Cmd.Tier); if (Result.Error == FEditError::None) { State.ActionLog.push_back(...); } ... }  // no bTerminal check; Step: if (State.bTerminal) { return; }
findings.detail: New in the r3-audited surface (3 lenses + Perkins). Unreachable in slice-1 live paths (no terminal transition yet); story 1.4's game-over hits it.
findings.recommended_fix: Guard ApplyEdit with bTerminal (return an error), or document that the freeze is Step-scoped only.

findings.title: FPPSimDriver::Advance clamps only the upper bound — a negative delta is UB (float->uint64 cast) and a runaway step loop
findings.evidence: DeltaSeconds = FMath::Min(DeltaSeconds, MaxFrameDelta); AccumulatedSeconds += DeltaSeconds; const uint64_t TargetTick = static_cast<uint64_t>(FMath::FloorToDouble(static_cast<double>(AccumulatedSeconds) * SimHz));  // no Max(x, 0)
findings.detail: Latent (NativeTick passes dt >= 0), but the driver is shipped header API and the guard is one line.
findings.recommended_fix: Clamp DeltaSeconds to [0, MaxFrameDelta] (FMath::Clamp) and pin it in PPSimDriverTests.
